seed: User 2026-11-13: "i create a new video and i can't drag any videos from history into the timeline". History is one folder every Photonz on the Mac shows, and Shift Command H opens the History of whichever copy holds the shortcut, which is often not the copy the video is open in. Such a drag reached the timeline with nothing remembered on this side and a provider that answered nothing, so no ghost was drawn and nothing landed. A new empty video, History open, a recording and then a screenshot carried in from another app's History, each read off the drag itself as the History file. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.note: A recording carried from another Photonz's History onto the empty V1 of a new video draws its ghost while in the air and lands at 0:02, read off the drag as the History file itself rather than SwiftUI's copy of it
The same drag onto the video, which now holds that clip, let go under the tracks at 0:01, lands on a track of its own
A screenshot carried from another Photonz's History lands on a track of its own under the tracks, read off the drag as the History file
